title: Core Metadata & Design System
content:
Core metadata settings

Initial metadata settings associated with controls built into the interface:

  • type — is this a block level element OR a grid level element implying it can have things placed inside of it
  • canScale — hide the width scaler which is common
  • canEditSource — should users see the inline view source button
  • hideDefaultSettings — hides the designSystem and textual alignment options commonly present
  • designSystem — can define if accent, primary, card, text (font), and special design treatment form inputs should be shown

Gizmo

Gizmo provides the listing in the HAX editor — metadata and filtering that allows the button to render for users to click or drag onto the interface. This data also shows up in Merlin when typing to find related blocks.
